arg_browser: Only inspect this browser; the default is to try every supported browser.
arg_catalogue_delay: Initial delay in seconds between catalog requests.
arg_detail_delay: Initial delay in seconds between module detail requests.
arg_headed: Open a visible Chromium window so a security checkpoint can be completed.
arg_headed_legacy: Accepted for CLI compatibility; on the legacy HTTP macOS route, refresh the source browser and rerun if a security checkpoint appears.
arg_limit: Maximum number of candidate rooms to return (1-200).
arg_module_limit: Maximum number of candidate modules to return (1-200).
arg_query: Skill or requirement to search for; repeat for multiple requirements.
arg_skip_module_details: Do not read the official module details during this run.
arg_skip_validation: Do not validate every cached room URL during this run.
arg_validation_delay: Initial delay in seconds between room URL checks.
